page.title: People & access
page.description: Create company accounts and manage their access within {{company}}.
page.noAccess: You don't have access to People & access. Ask your company administrator.
page.loadFailed: The people list could not be loaded.

table.title: Organization members
table.description: Accounts with access to this company

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: What each role can do, and how many people in {{company}} have it. Roles are the same in every company.

tip.title: Access follows responsibility.
tip.description: Each person gets the role their job needs. Company roles never grant platform access.

manage.title: Manage {{name}}
manage.changeRoleNote: {{name}}'s role in {{company}} changes to {{role}} from their next request.
manage.deactivateConfirm: {{name}} loses access to {{company}} on their next request. Their other companies aren't affected.
manage.reactivateConfirm: {{name}} gets access to {{company}} again, with the same role.
manage.resetConfirm: This logs {{name}} out everywhere and gives you a one-time password to hand over.
manage.passwordNote: Shown once. Hand it over securely; they'll choose their own at the next login.

create.title: Create company user
create.description: Create an account and its role within {{company}}.
create.generatedNote: Copy it before creating: it isn't shown again.
create.roleNote: Choose the role this person needs. Creating an account never grants platform access.
create.handover: Hand over the password securely. It doesn't appear in the confirmation.
create.tipDescription: Share the login details securely. They'll choose their own password at the first login.

created.title: Company user created
created.description: {{name}}'s account and {{role}} membership are ready within {{company}}.
created.handover: Share the login details securely. {{name}} signs in on the same login page and chooses their own password at the first login.

errors.invalidUsername: Usernames need 3-64 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address without spaces or accented letters.
errors.passwordRule: Use 8-128 characters with an upper-case letter, a lower-case letter, a number and a symbol.
errors.taken: That username or email is already in use.
errors.notAllowed: You can't do this for this person.
errors.notFound: That person isn't in this company any more.
errors.self: You can't do this to your own account.
